hints.title: Phrase Boundary Overlap
hints.text: Two phrases A and B can form a puzzle if the last word of phrase A is identical to the first word of phrase B.

hints.title: Word Separation
hints.text: Split each phrase into its first word, middle/last words, and last word.

hints.title: Merge and Deduplicate
hints.text: Join phrase A with phrase B minus its first word whenever the overlap matches and indices differ. Return all distinct formed phrases sorted lexicographically.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full pairwise comparison without first/last word tokenization causes repeated string scanning.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tokenizing boundary words permits direct matching and set-based deduplication.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle single-word phrases correctly and avoid self-pairing with the same index.
complexity.notes: Final list must be sorted in lexicographical order.
